correctness.rationale: Exact integral state recurrences and affine invariant checked. Both projective Möbius maps have determinant -2 and odd denominators, are parity-complementary and 2-adic one-step contractions, giving every normalized residue. The RL^k vertical loop scales by -5/3, which generates exactly all 1+8 units. Unit scaling and the projective branches give surjectivity and infinite witnesses. Each modular target has precisely two incoming labeled edges, so the finite reachable, aperiodic, doubly stochastic chain converges to uniform; binary block decomposition yields full natural densities. Checker exhaustively confirms the nonstandard structural ingredients for k<=8, independently of the proof.

value.rationale: The natural negative-integer evaluation of classical Stern polynomials has a non-obvious affine index-eight pair obstruction but no obstruction for individual residues; the complete support at all 2-power levels, exact individual natural densities, and 2-adic closure quantify this structure. Contraction plus a full principal-unit scaling loop provide a structural mechanism missing from ordinary t=1 results. This is a motivated complete invariant, not a routine table or bare congruence check.
